name: Stray Cat
source:
"Meow"

A stray cat that used t o live around the Penny Lane where Teuta lived.

After the building collapsed, it wandered into Scarecrow's place along with Teuta and has been living together ever since. 

Somehow is very fond of Shuu and Mozu, but are like cats and dogs with Scarecrows.

(Its name will be changed along with the progression of the story to: Max, Neko, Teuta, Ana, Ginger)
